text:
Priya Menon: Quick sync  small PR to update the quotas & pricing docs for tiered metering and burst-credit semantics. Need: tiny curl + python snippets showing the X-Redwood-Metering v2 header and a legacy fallback, an iframe for the new "Consumption by Tier" panel, and sign-off on the copy about when credits are applied. Anyone able to take code + iframe verify + L10n?
Alex Chen: I can draft the snippets (curl + python requests). Will include the fallback header example and a one-line note about escaping quotes in some shells.
Jordan Lee: Dashboard panel moved yesterday. New link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers?panelId=tiers-21. iframe: <iframe src="https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers?panelId=tiers-21" width="100%" height="360"></iframe>
Samir Patel: Copy tweak: replace "consumed on submit" -> "applied when the request completes successfully." Also note that queued requests reserve credits until completion and release them on timeout.
Maria Gonzales: I'll prepare the Spanish translation: "los cre9ditos de re1faga se aplican cuando la solicitud finaliza correctamente" and check pluralization in usage examples.
Priya Menon: Thanks. I'll open a draft PR #4271: docs/metering/tiered-quickfix and assign Alex (code), Jordan (iframe verify), Samir (copy), Maria (L10n). DocBot: please ping #docs in 48h if there are no approvals.
DocBot: Reminder scheduled: will post in #docs in 48 hours if PR #4271 has no approvals. :robot_face:
Alex Chen: pushing the snippet branch now, will link the PR when ready.
Priya Menon: Great  once L10n and iframe verification are done, I'll merge and add the release-note blurb.
